title: Pip Listens for Home
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters nd, nt, nk.

pages.brief: Leaves and twigs blowing hard across the garden in a strong wind.
Pip the sparrow squinting through blowing dust, unable to see his nest.
Small bits of grit and dust spinning and swirling in the strong wind.
Pip the sparrow standing firm on a branch, steadying himself in the wind.
Pip the sparrow standing still, sheltering close to a branch.
Sound-ripple lines spreading out from the direction of the pond towards Pip.
Pip the sparrow hopping quickly towards the sound, wings half out.
Pip the sparrow arriving back at his twiggy nest at last.
Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling resting together, sheltered in the nest.
